title: Checkpoint
scope: Product Strategy, Brand Identity, UX/UI Design, Web Application Development, Dashboard Design
role: Design and development of a connected financial management experience for VICOBA groups and community investment clubs.
summary: Checkpoint brings contributions, member records, lending, investments and group finances into one organised digital workspace.
A product-design case study presenting authentic Checkpoint interfaces, illustrated using fictional financial and member records.
introductionTitle: Financial clarity for groups growing together.
introduction: Community investment groups depend on regular contributions, transparent financial records and reliable oversight of savings and loans. Checkpoint brings these activities together in an approachable digital platform.
Designed for group administrators and individual members, Checkpoint makes it easier to follow contributions, review lending activity and understand the financial position of the club.
The portfolio presentation uses real product interfaces rendered with fictional member and financial data. It does not represent actual customer finances or independently measured outcomes.
challenge: Group treasurers and administrators may need to reconcile payments, loans, interest, expenses and member balances across separate records. That can make reporting and accountability more difficult as a club grows.
Members also need an understandable view of their contributions and borrowing position, while administrators require a broader operational picture without compromising clarity.
approach: We built Checkpoint around a central financial overview that surfaces group cash, equity, contributions, loans and other key records, supported by focused modules for everyday administration.
The experience separates administrator and member responsibilities while using a consistent product language across dashboard tables, financial charts, contribution tracking and mobile views.
Checkpoint's existing blue-and-mint brand identity anchors the case-study presentation, combining screenshots captured from its real React and Astro interfaces with composed editorial boards.
features: Loan register, balances and repayment oversight
Member management and personal finance views
Automated fines and contribution follow-up workflows
Responsive web experience for administrators and members
outcome: A functioning product experience for organising investment club finance around a shared, clearer set of records and workflows.
An extensible financial-management foundation; the case study illustrates the product design without asserting user adoption, return on investment or financial improvements.
overview: A connected financial management platform for VICOBA groups and community investment clubs.
problem: Group contributions, loans, investments and member reporting can become difficult to coordinate using disconnected financial records.
solution: Checkpoint provides a unified dashboard and role-specific interfaces to track club finances, contributions and loans with greater everyday visibility.
